functions.name: findtravelpath
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete upstream hack.c findtravelpath() definition (1266-1523), including the adjacent fast path, endpoint reversal for TRAVP_VALID and TRAVP_GUESS, source-ordered breadth-first traversal, NODIAG direction bound, couldsee filtering while guessing, delayed closed-door/boulder/trap candidates and one-repeat frontier rule, TEST_TRAV visibility, travel-map reads and writes, visited-target message and run reset, and the TRAVP_GUESS ranking, direct fallback, and noguess restart. Checked evaluation order and the no-RNG contract of the path search against the JavaScript helpers; no unported return-valued callee is substituted. Removed the unreachable-target refusal from domove_core and preserved the source's messages, state changes, screen ownership, and RNG behavior.

callers.source: hack.c domove_core() 2724-2728 calls findtravelpath(TRAVP_TRAVEL), then findtravelpath(TRAVP_GUESS) when the ordinary path search fails; the JavaScript domove_core() follows that same dispatch before ordinary movement.
hack.c is_valid_travelpt() 1538-1540 temporarily changes u.tx/u.ty and calls findtravelpath(TRAVP_VALID); JavaScript preserves and restores those target fields around the production validator call.
getpos.c's travel destination validation calls is_valid_travelpt(); js/getpos.js invokes the JavaScript validator while selecting a travel target, which reaches findtravelpath(TRAVP_VALID).

entryPointReview: The selected runnable entry point is keyboard travel through hack.c domove_core(): it first attempts TRAVP_TRAVEL and, for an inaccessible target, enters TRAVP_GUESS to choose a visible reachable point and restart the ordinary path search. The independent clean travel recipe and matching recording exercise this production path. The debug world-tour recipe also reaches the guess acceptance movement, but its recording is blocked after that movement by the unrelated trap_effects.js dotrap() trap activation boundary; it remains committed as a recipe for later replay. The validator entry point is getpos.c is_valid_travelpt(), which reaches TRAVP_VALID through js/getpos.js and is covered by the focused travel validation test. The source range contains no other command or dispatcher entry point.
